independent_technical_reasoning: nBIF sits on PCIe-facing NBIO paths, so a parity event may affect multiple downstream devices even when classified correctable. The presence of iohub_instance in an nBIF command is not self-explanatory and must be decoded from the tool. A correctable record is only meaningful when source bank/count and dependent link health show containment without hidden retrain or reset.
